name: The Gaza Pull Out
overview: The Scriptures reveal God's judgment upon Gaza due to its persistent transgressions, including the captivity and betrayal of others, as Amos declares that punishment will not be withheld. Prophetic warnings describe a fiery destruction of Gaza's strongholds and the eventual forsaking and desolation of the city, as affirmed by Zephaniah. Jeremiah's prophecies connect Gaza with the surrounding Philistine cities, emphasizing the comprehensive nature of God's judgment against these peoples.
